verified_facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Santa Fe, opposite the Palace of the Governors and steps from the historic Plaza.
verified_facts.excerpt: Downtown Santa Fe, opposite the Palace of the Governors and steps from the historic Plaza

verified_facts.text: Guestrooms have handcrafted furnishings and traditional wood ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: modern interpretation of Santa Fe’s Southwestern spirit with handcrafted furnishings and traditional wood ceilings

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler's reviewer had a traditional New Mexican kiva fireplace in the corner of his room.
verified_facts.excerpt: My room even featured a cozy traditional New Mexican Kiva fireplace in the corner.

verified_facts.text: The Anasazi Restaurant serves contemporary American cuisine inspired by local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Contemporary American cuisine inspired by local ingredients.

verified_facts.text: The Anasazi Restaurant's dishes are guided by the seasons and sourced from local farms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guided by the seasons and sourced from local farms

verified_facts.text: Chef Cristian Pontiggia, a native of Lombardy, was named Chef of the Year in New Mexico 2023 by the New Mexico Restaurant Association.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lombardy native Chef Cristian has won numerous awards such as Chef of the Year in New Mexico 2023 from the New Mexico Restaurant Association

verified_facts.text: The wine collection numbers over 900 wines, curated by the in-house wine director.
verified_facts.excerpt: an expansive collection of over 900 wines, curated by the in-house wine director

verified_facts.text: The basement wine cellar doubles as a private dining room that can be reserved for intimate gatherings.
verified_facts.excerpt: All wines are stored in the basement wine cellar which doubles as a private dining room that can be reserved for intimate gatherings.

verified_facts.text: The Patio is the hotel's plaza restaurant, set in the heart of downtown.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rosewood Inn of the Anasazi's plaza restaurant is set in the heart of downtown.

verified_facts.text: Custom Anasazi bicycles are available for guest use, with suggested routes including Canyon Road and the Railyard District.
verified_facts.excerpt: custom ANASAZI bicycles are available for guest use. Suggested routes would be as follows: Santa Fe Plaza/Historic Square, Canyon Road, Railyard District, and River Route.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers guests a complimentary car service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anasazi offers a complimentary car service, as well as free bikes

verified_facts.text: There is no spa or pool on site.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is no spa or pool on-site

verified_facts.text: The hotel can arrange in-room massage and aromatherapy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax and rejuvenate with Santa Fe luxury massage and aromatherapy. Rosewood Inn of the Anasazi can arrange expert in-room services during your stay.

verified_facts.text: A guided tasting of premium tequilas is offered, and reservations are required.
verified_facts.excerpt: A unique guided tasting of a variety of distinguished premium tequilas

verified_facts.text: A Bespoke Romantic Dinner includes a five-course wine pairing menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: This experience includes a 5-course wine pairing menu

verified_facts.text: The hotel can guide guests toward hiking trails in the landscapes just beyond the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the beauty of Santa Fe’s rugged landscapes with breathtaking hiking trails just beyond the city.

verified_facts.text: The name Anasazi refers to the Native American civilization that once inhabited the Four Corners region.
verified_facts.excerpt: The name Anasazi refers to the Native American civilization that once inhabited the Four Corners region

verified_facts.text: The inn welcomes families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inn of the Anasazi welcomes families with its Southwestern hospitality.

verified_facts.text: Accessible rooms have a king-size bed and an intimate sitting area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Comfortable room with king-size bed and intimate sitting area

verified_facts.text: The hotel was a Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards honoree in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2024 and 2025.
